name: Ahmed Shafei
headline: Director of Products at ADHDS | Ex-McKinsey
location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
summary:
Ahmed is a Product Management Director at Abu Dhabi Health Data Services (ADHDS), where he leads digital strategy and delivery of innovative HealthTech products. He has over 10 years of experience in product management, software engineering, and applied research. Ahmed holds a MS in Computer Science from the Technical University of Munich and several professional certifications in product management and agile. He speaks Arabic, English, German, and worked in Europe, USA, China, and Middle East.

Ahmed is passionate about creating user-centric and data-driven solutions that leverage cutting-edge technologies. He is skilled in Digital Strategy and Roadmapping, Product Lifecycle Management, Digital Transformation, Agile and Scrum Methodologies, Market Analysis and Research, User-Centric Design Thinking, Data-Driven Decision Making, Pricing and Monetization Strategies, GTM Strategy, Data Analytics and Metrics Tracking, Customer Journey Mapping, Requirements Elicitation, and Rapid Prototyping.

company.name: Abu Dhabi Health Data Services
company.tagline: Building Tomorrow's Healthcare with AI, Data & Digital Transformation
company.description:
M42’s Abu Dhabi Health Data Services (ADHDS) is a premier digital healthcare solutions company serving as a strategic catalyst for advancing the healthcare ecosystem in Abu Dhabi and beyond. ADHDS digitally empowers health by championing innovative solutions to elevate the quality of care, expand access, optimise costs, and unlock efficiencies on a national, regional, and global scale. Harnessing the power of data and technology, ADHDS drives transformative change across the healthcare eco-system and makes a lasting impact on the communities they serve.

ADHDS established a Private-Public Partnership (PPP) with the Department of Health Abu Dhabi (DOH) to build and operate Malaffi, the trailblazing Abu Dhabi Health Information Exchange (HIE). Following the successful delivery of Malaffi, as one of the fastest rolled-out and most advanced HIEs globally, ADHDS has become renowned for successfully delivering major national digital healthcare transformational projects, acting as a critical link between regulators, governments, healthcare providers, biopharma companies, and patient communities. ADHDS is an asset of M42, a global health leader powered by artificial intelligence and technology to transform care for all.
